lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs4Bi4Ag2Cl18 (reduced formula Cs2Bi2AgCl9) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 148), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Bi each coordinated by six Cl neighbors in octahedral environments, while Cs adopts a close-packed-like arrangement with 12 Cl neighbors. The Ag and Bi octahedra share corners with one another and face-sharing is observed between Cs polyhedra and the Ag and Bi octahedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
